description.value: The Rusty Anchor is the pub and dining room at the Penticton Yacht Club and Marina, a not-for-profit society perched on the south shore of Okanagan Lake. The setting is a working marina with 450 berths and an active keelboat racing community, giving the venue a distinctly nautical character unlike most Okanagan dining stops. Sunday Brunch is a featured offering, making it a memorable waterfront detour for cyclists riding the Okanagan rail trail corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this place 'Rusty's' but the website at pycmarina.com consistently calls the venue 'The Rusty Anchor' — only the URL slug 'rustys-pub' echoes the OSM name. Contact details (293 Marina Way, Penticton, BC V2A 1H5; 250-770-2000) were drawn from the website's /contact/ subpage since OSM carries no address or phone. No amenity-specific evidence (bike parking, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, etc.) appears anywhere in the fetched website content, so all amenity fields are null.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records this as 'Rusty's' but the website consistently uses 'The Rusty Anchor' as the venue name; the URL slug 'rustys-pub' appears to be a legacy or informal reference.
URL discovery confidence was rated 'medium/uncertain' — the URL was coord-matched rather than pulled directly from OSM tags.

The venue is embedded within a yacht club that references social membership; public dining access is implied by 'Eat at the Rusty Anchor' navigation link but membership requirements for entry are not fully clarified on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant and pub at an active marina; website shows current 2026 programming and seasonal hours confirming the business is open.
enrichment_extras.notes: Phone 250-770-2000 and address 293 Marina Way are the general Penticton Yacht Club and Marina contact details; no separate direct line for the restaurant is listed. Email pentictonyachtclub@outlook.com is the general club contact.
